task.title: To view or edit a segment style

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home icon () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the Dropdown icon ()and select Segments.

SelectSegment Regular from the segments list in the Segments pane and click the Settings icon () next to the segment name. This opens the Segment Settingspage where the Segment Type is set to Regular for that segment.
To edit the style, click theEdit icon () next to Style.

To add a segment condition, click Add Condition. This opens the Segment Condition window which has the expression builder. For more information, see To make a Segment Conditional in a template. After adding a condition to the segment, a Lightning icon () is added. Segment Regular style segment changes to Segment Conditional after you add a condition. When you generate a document using a template with style segments, you can view the different styles applied in the generated document.
